title: Model Routing
content: Model Routing routeModel(...) in src/lib/control-plane/orchestration.ts implements deterministic route decisions. Policy: Fail closed when privacy is local_only and only external backend is available. Reject long-context path when retrieval is sufficient. Return explicit degraded decisions when structured output is required but unsupported. Prefer the lowest safe cost model class ( small , code_reasoning , long_context ) based on handoff state
summary: routeModel(...) in src/lib/control-plane/orchestration.ts implements deterministic route decisions.
